AS-REP. Filtering it dropped EXECSQL (DA+SPN) on real VMC collections.

tests/fixtures without production AD data. Ignore analysis/ exports.

isdc computers (e.g. DC01) were dropped by the highvalue-flood filter,
so dangerous ACLs like DnsAdmins GenericAll on DCs were never reported.
Restores DC HV inclusion and engagement s14 gate.

fix: speed up Session/LocalAdmin summary on large graphs

in-pass examples. Avoids O(E×computers) list scans that hung
enterprise collections under --quick-wins / --sessions.

release asset names to bloodbash in usage text.

match after stripping box-drawing glyphs. Also assert examples
use bloodbash, not BloodBash.py.
